blocks.text: QUEZON, Bukidnon — The municipality of Quezon rolled out the red carpet for its 9,538 registered senior citizens on Thursday, turning the Quezon Civic Arena into a vibrant gathering place for the town’s 10th Senior Citizens’ Day celebration. Thousands of senior citizens from the town’s 31 barangays gathered for a day dedicated to kalipay (joy), wellness, and community fellowship. The local government ensured accessibility by providing free transportation, with pick-up and drop-off arrangements for participants from remote areas.
